$comment: TriggerModel — GitHub (ballerinax/trigger.github). GitHub exposes MANY selectable service types (event channels): the user picks ONE event channel at init time via the 'serviceType' SINGLE_SELECT (codedata SERVICE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR), and that service type's full handler set is generated. Every service type lists ALL its remote handlers in `functions` (locked: enabled:true, editable:false, nameEditable:false); there are NO schemaFunctions because nothing is added later from a catalog. serviceTypes[].enabled marks the selected type (IssuesService here); the rest are editable:true so the user can switch. Each handler takes a single `payload` param of the channel's event record and returns error?. initProperties.listener is a CHOICE: 'Create New Listener' (generates `listener github:Listener githubListener = new(<listenOn>, {webhookSecret: ...})`) vs 'Use Existing Listener' (SINGLE_SELECT_LISTENER). Assumptions: (a) the IssuesService handler set follows the service-type DESCRIPTION (onOpened/onClosed/onReopened/onAssigned/onUnassigned/onLabeled/onUnlabeled) rather than the inbuilt file's function array, which contains a duplicated onAssigned and omits onUnassigned; (b) IssueCommentService payloads are github:IssueCommentEvent (the inbuilt file's onCreated payload type github:IssuesEvent is a known data bug); (c) the listener constructor shape `new(int|http:Listener listenOn, github:ListenerConfig {webhookSecret})` is inferred from the package README and the init form.
